about: The errors a hosted MakersMCP gives that no kit says, as a tool result shows them, with <...> for the variable parts. A playbook may quote these; tests/playbooks.test.mjs checks every error a topic quotes against the kits, makersmcp's src and this list. Each entry names where its text is made; MakersMCP-Api's and MakersMCP-Server's tests can keep this list true. Read from MakersMCP-Api origin/main bd34f07 and MakersMCP-Server origin/main 54ed753, and from their local mains where an entry names a commit not pushed yet, by its subject.
